blurb: Great Northern Railway Depot: Built in 1894, the year after the tracks were completed the Depot was originally located on the south side of the line. During an expansion of the rail yard in 1922, the building was moved to a location on Railroad Ave and enlarged to include a freight room. No longer an active depot, it is now owned by the City of Skykomish and will be the center of a new community complex.
